person.name: Jinto Jose
person.title: Head of Product
person.summary: Head of Product with 13+ years in the data domain. Specialist in data product design, financial data systems, and AI-native application development. Now building and shipping full-stack AI applications with Claude API, React, Next.js, Vercel, Firebase and Supabase.

projects.name: Inbox Intelligence
projects.description: End-to-end AI pipeline that surfaces what actually matters from your inbox. Built with Claude API, Gmail API, and Vercel. Full-stack AI application built from scratch.

projects.name: Encyclical Companion
projects.description: AI-powered companion app for deep reading of Catholic papal encyclicals. Features timeline, themes, personal notes, and AI-powered study chat.

projects.name: Vita
projects.description: Personal health tracker with a chat-first input port — plain sentences like 'slept 5h, 8k steps' are parsed into structured data, then shown back as a swipeable dashboard of rings, trends and streaks. MVP live, invite-only.

projects.name: Banking AI Operating Models
projects.description: Interactive research tool comparing AI Hub-and-Spoke operating models across ING, DBS, JP Morgan, Emirates NBD, Revolut, and Bank of America. Covers AI governance, build vs buy decisions, and cultural readiness.

projects.name: AI Transformation Project
projects.description: Documenting and driving the shift to AI-native ways of working within an organisation. Covers tooling, process change, and team capability building.

projects.name: Value at Risk
projects.description: Portfolio-level Value at Risk (VaR) designed as a consumable data product. Built around data product principles: discoverable, addressable, trustworthy, self-describing. Not a static report.

projects.name: Daily PnL
projects.description: Real-time daily profit and loss as a self-describing data asset. Built for financial decision-makers, not analysts.

projects.name: Innovation Index for Dev Teams
projects.description: Turns the qualitative question 'are we innovative?' into a measurable, Product Owner-aligned KPI set. Applies data product design thinking to engineering team performance intelligence.

projects.name: Goal: Zero Contact
projects.description: Data product designed to drive customer contact rates to zero through proactive, intelligent data surfaces.

projects.name: Notio Spiritus
projects.description: Independent app studio building EU-hosted, privacy-first products that respect your time and your data. Umbrella for Momentum and future apps, backed by a private library of reusable Claude skills (Notio-Spiritus-Skills).

projects.name: Momentum
projects.description: Habit tracker built on one opinionated constraint: only 3 habits. Migrated off Base44 to a fully-owned stack (React, Supabase, Vercel) - installable PWA with an autonomous activation agent. A Notio Spiritus product.

projects.name: ReginaCaeliCreations
projects.description: E-commerce site for a home baker — rum-soaked Christmas plum cake, home-baked in The Hague. Migrated off Base44 to a hand-built static site on its own domain. Real product, real user, and it's family.

projects.name: Womb Prayer Prep
projects.description: Mobile-first PWA for a 280-day (40-week) womb-prayer journey — a Malayalam devotional book transcribed and translated to English, fully bilingual, with two parents sharing one journey. Shipped and in use; content-complete (v2.0.0).

projects.name: Kids Crossword Puzzle
projects.description: Trilingual crossword game for a family of three kids — English, Dutch and Malayalam, with difficulty tiers, image-and-audio clues for the youngest, and a simple local leaderboard. No ads, no accounts, no arcade mechanics.

projects.name: PL Wheel Assessment
projects.description: Petra PL Wheel assessment framework turned into a product artifact — doc, code, and measurable outcome.
